name: role_setup
description: Set up an AI employee role by decomposing its role responsibility document into required skills and tools, researching and creating any missing capabilities, and producing a comprehensive Role Setup Report. Runs a nested breakdown-then-aggregate pipeline: outer breakdown identifies skill/tool subtasks (associate existing, extend, or create new); inner pipeline researches and synthesizes each subtask.

parameters.name: role_document_path
parameters.description: Path to the role responsibility document (Markdown) produced by create_role. E.g. './roles/devops_engineer.md'.

parameters.name: --max-facets
parameters.description: Maximum number of outer skill/tool subtasks to break the role into.

parameters.name: --max-inner-facets
parameters.description: Maximum number of inner research subtasks per outer skill/tool subtask.

returns: A Role Setup Report (role_setup_report.md) covering: existing tools associated to role needs, new tools/skills created, SOP-to-tool wiring, gaps and future work, and a verification plan.
